user_query: I'm organizing a charity event and I need some unique items for the auction. Can you find me some interesting listings on Etsy that can be used for a charity auction? Additionally, provide me with the product details for a specific item code from H&M that can be included in the auction. Lastly, suggest some cashback offers for my charity event purchases.

TaskList.description: Search for unique items on Etsy that can be used for a charity auction.
Request product details from H&M using a specific item code.
Find cashback offers available for charity event purchases.
